edge_thesis: This portfolio targets macro mean-reversion and trend continuation in highly liquid, low-friction instruments (ETFs and major FX) while capping crypto exposure to avoid its 52bp round-trip drag. On the other side of these trades are short-term leveraged momentum chasers and systematic risk-parity funds forced to rebalance around intraday volatility spikes, creating favorable R-multiple asymmetry when stops are placed outside normal single-bar noise.

picks.why: Central bank accumulation and real-yield hedging provide a steady bid with low 6.71bp ETF friction.
Long-duration Treasuries offer asymmetric upside on any growth scare or equity pullback.
Captures USD mean-reversion in the deepest FX pair with tight 7.53bp round-trip costs.
High-beta liquidity proxy sized small to absorb 52bp execution drag and wide intrabar swings.
